updated: e20261206b: Santa’s grotto at Mason’s Yard, petting farm at the Rose & Crown and Santa’s parade from Wimbledon Village Stables — Christmas in the Village runs 10:00–17:00. Visit the grotto 10:00–16:30 or the petting farm 11:00–15:00. Santa’s horseback parade leaves the stables at 13:30. Tree lighting and carols start at the Village War Memorial at 17:00.

e20261203d: The Grove Christmas Market & Surbiton station lights switch-on — Celebrate Surbiton at Christmas runs 16:30–21:30. Santa arrives at Surbiton station at 17:15, the tree lights go on at 17:30 and station entertainment ends at 19:30. The Grove craft market closes at 21:30. Its opening time is unpublished.

e20261112: Market stalls at All Saints Church and Pyramid Bar stage at Kingston Ancient Market Place — Kingston Christmas Market opens at 10:00. The All Saints stalls finish on 24 December. The Ancient Market Place runs to 3 January, closing on Christmas Day. Live sets at the Pyramid Bar follow a separate stage timetable.
e20261206: TwickFolk Christmas Special: Jackie Oates & John Spiers — English carols, wassails and fiddle and melodeon tunes. The organiser and box office report a sell-out. A waiting list is open.

e20261127d: Food stalls at Jubilee Square, Christmas fair at New Malden Methodist Church and High Street lights — New Malden Christmas Party runs 15:30–19:00. The Methodist church fair opens 16:30–19:00 with free entry, face painting and decoration making. The High Street lights switch on at 17:30.

e20261129g: Thames Ditton High Street stalls, live music and Christmas lights — Thames Ditton Christmas Fayre starts at 15:00. Elmbridge Borough Council confirms the lights switch on at 17:00. Individual music times are unpublished.
